svg.title: 4-Case Prime Divisibility Triage and Elementary Divisors of Edge Hecke Operators
svg.desc: Publication-grade two-panel editorial mathematical diagram uniting Stage 03 LocalDivisibility.lean (Left Panel) and ElementaryDivisorTheorem.lean (Right Panel), anchored by a bottom valuation-domain strip. The Left Panel depicts the 4-case prime triage in New.Data.exists_colengthDvd_gaugeLe_compositeLift, which produces an O-submodule S of integral source forms M with determinant-divisibility colength ColengthDvd M S (p^l), l <= allowedLoss(p) * dim, and composite-lift valuation at least gain(p) - allowedLoss(p): Case 1 (circle, emerald, split or p >= x_1, p != N) has gain = 0, allowedLoss = 0, S = M, l = 0 via gaugeLe_restrictedChain_one; Case 2 (open diamond, cobalt, non-exceptional small non-split p < x_1) satisfies m * collisionSum <= loss(p), S = M, l = 0, valuation >= gain - 2 * loss via gaugeLe_restrictedChain_collisionSum; Case 3 (filled diamond, highlighted rust, exceptional inert p < x_1 with chi_K(p) = -1, p != +-1 mod m, odd order o_0 <= r_frak) selects a full mark Lambda, sets Y = prod_{l in Lambda} scaledHeckeOperator(l) and S = Y^m M + p^{j_p} M with colength l <= loss(p) * dim via gaugeLe_restrictedChain_of_isFullMark and isOntoUpToColength_prod_scaledHeckeOperator_pow, receiving its colength bound directly via a cross-panel bridge arrow from Step 3 on the Right Panel; Case 4 (triangle, dashed amber, level prime p = N) has gain = 0, allowedLoss = 2mfb, S = upIntegralForms (Up^{m/2} phi integral for L_0), colength l <= mfb * dim, using ramification via gaugeLe_compositeLift_at_N. The Right Panel displays the factorization of edgeHeckeOperator (edgeHeckeOperator_regroup) as M (integral functions on lattices) subset M_all (originFunctions) subset M_edge (edge functions) mapped by Add = pairingMap to N_cal (dual to allEdgesForms) subset M^circ, with small colength det d | w^l (exists_basis_det_dvd) marked at both outer inclusions. Below the factorization pipe, a 3-step engine powers the middle Add step: Step 1 (exists_isEdgeCondition) combines Frobenius cycle T of N alternating letters with RootLemma::stepanov_count, AveragingMap Av, and DefectCount Pieri cone volume to prove index * dim S <= (1 + theta) |Exponents|; Step 2 builds the near inverse Inv (pow_dvd_mul_sub_smul_one: Add * Inv == p^{2 N c_0} mod w^c), applies Smith normal form modulo a direct summand (exists_elementary_divisors_mod_summand), and invokes Nakayama's lemma (smul_top_le_of_le_sup_smul_top) so p^{2 N c_0} N_cal is covered by Add(M_all) plus at most theta |V| |Exp| extra generators; Step 3 outputs FrobeniusCycle.elementary_divisors: IsOntoUpToColength p L m Y ((3 c_div + theta m) |X| |I|), which feeds directly across the center bridge into Case 3 on the Left Panel. The bottom strip records that O = embValRing subset C is a characteristic-zero, non-noetherian, non-discrete valuation domain containing w = sqrtPrime (w^2 = p), so determinant-divisibility ColengthDvd replaces finite-module length throughout both files.

g.text: ∃ S ⊆ M: det | pl (l ≤ allowedLoss·dim), vp ≥ gain − allowedLoss

O (embValRing ⊂ ℂ) is a char-0 non-noetherian, non-discrete valuation domain containing w = sqrtPrime (w² = p).
Quotients M / S need not have finite length, so determinant-divisibility ColengthDvd replaces finite-module length.
